items.title: Rackspace shuts down Spot cloud platform after security breach
items.description: Rackspace is shutting down its Rackspace Spot cloud platform after a security breach allowed hackers to access customer Kubernetes clusters and secrets, giving customers until December 8 to migrate their services and download their data. [...]

items.title: 'God Mode' Flaws Could Wreak Border-Control Havoc

items.title: Radware discloses breach exposing customer cloud access keys

items.description: Broadcom has disclosed 23 VMware vulnerabilities, including two critical flaws that could let attackers run code directly on ESX hosts and a third that could let them access vCenter without signing in. items.description: A new Linux backdoor called ZQAgent is giving attackers a long-term foothold on compromised servers. It can run commands, move through folders, read files and open network tunnels. It also hides itself to look like a normal system process. The malware was dropped by ARTEX, an AI-driven hacking framework.
